fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: We believe you should be able to have treatment when you need it, not when you can afford it. Payment is due on the day of treatment, and there are more ways to manage it than most people expect.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept cash, EFTPOS, Visa and Mastercard. A small surcharge may apply on credit card payments.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bring your health fund card and we claim on the spot with HICAPS - you only pay the gap. All health funds are welcome, including HCF, Bupa, Medibank, nib, CBHS, Teachers Health, Defence Health, Australian Unity and GMHBA.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Child Dental Benefits Schedule covers up to $1,158 of basic dental services per eligible child over two consecutive calendar years, bulk billed with no out-of-pocket cost for covered services. The cap is indexed each January.

fields.label: Small print
fields.value: Eligibility is set by Services Australia - check your child’s eligibility.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept DVA Gold and White cards. Please present your card before treatment begins so we can arrange billing for you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept Oral Health Fee For Service Scheme (OHFFSS) vouchers for the Hunter area. The voucher is issued by the public dental service at their discretion, not by us, so start with them if you think you qualify.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you’re 60 or over, a 5% discount applies to your treatment. Just mention it at reception.

fields.value: Reception at Tooth n Care, where health fund claims are processed on the spot

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Buy now, pay later for dental treatment in interest-free instalments. Apply at checkout or through the Humm app in a few minutes.

fields.label: Small print
fields.value: Lending criteria, fees and terms and conditions apply. About Humm

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A simple direct-debit plan with no interest and no credit check - a $39 establishment fee, for treatment plans over $1,000. Pay weekly, fortnightly or monthly over up to 18 months.

fields.label: Small print
fields.value: Lending criteria, fees and terms and conditions apply. About DentiCare

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For essential dental treatment, the ATO’s Compassionate Release of Super can apply - covering implants and dentures, oral and maxillofacial surgery, braces and orthodontics, root canal treatment, crowns and general dentistry. SuperCare is our preferred facilitator; they charge no fee unless your application is approved.

fields.label: Small print
fields.value: Conditions apply and approval sits with the ATO. SuperCare for Tooth n Care patients

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Every treatment plan we give you comes with clear pricing before anything starts - inclusions, exclusions and any deposit spelled out. Ask us to walk you through the options; it takes five minutes.
